originalGameDefinition: Original 7x6 K4, all69 original unwrapped H,V,R,F windows, one actual owner per physical site, gravity, alternating turn, stop at firstwinner.

soundSufficientTheorem.q: Any genuine original firstwinfree q with P1 to move.
soundSufficientTheorem.notation: S_p(q)={legal gravity landing cells e where original Pp K4 already has exactly 3 Pp stones and missing just e}.
preconditions: S_1(q) is empty: P1 cannot FIRSTWIN immediately.
S_0(q) has exactly one true physical landing y.
soundSufficientTheorem.forcedFirstP1Reply: P1 must occupy y. Any other P1 move leaves y playable and P0 FIRSTWINS immediately on its next turn.
soundSufficientTheorem.afterCompulsoryBlock: If S_0(q+P1(y)) nonempty then P0 FIRSTWINS on next turn.
soundSufficientTheorem.secondStage: Otherwise if there is an actual legal P0 move z from q+P1(y) that firstwins immediately, or creates >=2 distinct currently playable P0 K4 singleton targets with S_1 empty at the resulting P1-to-move state, then P0 wins in at most its next two turns. P1 can't block two different playable sites with one stone and cannot firstwin on its intervening turn.
soundSufficientTheorem.output: Sound forced original Player0 FIRSTWIN within next four plies from q, including any earlier P0 firstwin.
soundSufficientTheorem.type: Sufficient not necessary; local two-tier source Boolean danger-intersection; original owner one-/two-missing K4 projectors and gravity only; no future game values, no historic28 or root solver labels.

concreteDisjointResponseSets.disjointInterference: P1 diagonal-response set {c5r4} and preemptive third-row P4 fork pivot response set {c3r3,c6r3} have empty intersection. Thus if P1 blocks R, P0 creates H fork; otherwise P0 wins R on21.

relatedNonimportableMath.strictNontransfer: That paper's polynomial structural winner theorem is for unrestricted rank3 Maker-Breaker hypergraphs. Original Connect4 is rank4 K4, gravity-restricted, Maker-Maker both firstwinner possibilities and DRAW; cannot claim its characterization proves Connect4 root WIN.
